mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND number=#{args[1]}
SELECT number,stage_no,revision,title,status,memory_version,published,summary FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY number
SELECT number,title,body,summary FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND status='ACCEPTED' ORDER BY number
SELECT number,title,summary FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND status='ACCEPTED' ORDER BY number
SELECT number,summary FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND status='ACCEPTED' ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT number,summary FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND status='ACCEPTED' AND number<#{args[1]} ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT #{args[2]}
SELECT body FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND number=#{args[1]} AND status='ACCEPTED'
SELECT number,title,published FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND number>=#{args[1]} ORDER BY number
SELECT number FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND number>=#{args[1]} AND published=TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS chapters,COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(body)),0) AS stored_characters FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND status='ACCEPTED'
mapper.update: INSERT INTO chapters(novel_id,number,stage_no,revision,title,body,status,memory_version,published) VALUES(#{args[0]},#{args[1]},#{args[2]},#{args[3]},#{args[4]},#{args[5]},'DRAFT',#{args[6]},FALSE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stage_no=#{args[2]},revision=#{args[3]},title=#{args[4]},body=#{args[5]}, status='DRAFT',memory_version=#{args[6]},published=FALSE
UPDATE chapters SET status='ACCEPTED',summary=#{args[0]},memory_version=#{args[1]} WHERE novel_id=#{args[2]} AND number=#{args[3]}
UPDATE chapters SET published=#{args[0]} WHERE novel_id=#{args[1]} AND number=#{args[2]} AND status='ACCEPTED'
UPDATE chapters SET status='INVALIDATED' WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND number>=#{args[1]}
